D-004.facts: The issuer of the quotations (Al Arabia) prints EP-15744 as its own Project ID and Oracle Job No. on other staged documents of the same project, and prints the same value on both quotations of F069. On the F069 pages themselves the value sits under a 'Refrence' label and nothing on those pages states its role.
D-004.ruling: AMBIGUOUS. Frozen section 2 makes 'ambiguous' the state for a readable value whose role cannot be established from the page; frozen section 3 never lets a job number be the identity but gives no rule that lets other documents establish the role on this page. Reading the role from F062/F068 is exactly the addition that topic (h2) makes to section 3, and (h2) is not an owner-approved amendment. The F062/F068 evidence and the repeat on two quotations make 'present' indefensible, and they corroborate that EP-15744 is the issuer's job number, but under the frozen text they do not convert the page to 'absent'. 'Absent' would be the right state only if the owner adopts (h2) as an amendment to section 3.

D-005.question: F019 p1: cell 'Rev. no.' 00 versus revision table latest row 01 dated 09-05-16 and title-block DATE 09-05-16. Does frozen section 4 cell-first give present '00', or is it ambiguous?

Title block: DATE 09-05-16, DRAWN AHMED, SCALE 1:150 @ A1, CHKD MJ, APPD MJ; 'DWG. NO: FAM-PIV-MAH-SPD-FA-2633-007'; 'Rev. no.' 00. Dewan REVIEW NOTE stamp with red arrow to APPROVED AS NOTED, 16.5.16.
page_evidence.C:/t/r2x/r32-stage/renders/F019-p1.png: Revision table (upside down in the render, read on a working rotation): REV 00, 05-03-16, ISSUED FOR APPROVAL, AHMED, MJ; REV 01, 09-05-16, AS PER CONSULTANT COMMENTS, AHMED, MJ.

D-005.facts: Both candidates are printed and legible. The 'Rev. no.' cell says 00; the table's latest row is 01 and its date equals the title-block DATE. The page does not state which is current; the dates suggest the cell was not updated, but that is an inference from dates.
D-005.ruling: PRESENT '00' under the frozen conventions. Frozen section 4 names the revision cell or title-block REV field the primary source and uses the revision table only 'when only a revision-history table is printed'. The frozen text therefore establishes which candidate is the field, so section 2's 'ambiguous' (cannot be established which candidate is the field) does not apply. The topic (i) sentence that would make a cell/table conflict ambiguous is an amendment to section 4; until the owner adopts it, it cannot govern. Disclosure: the page carries contrary evidence (table row 01 dated as the title block), so a prediction of '01' is plausible; the owner may prefer the (i) amendment, which would make the row ambiguous and remove F019 from the revision population.
